name: Alms
overview: Scripture instructs believers to show compassion and generosity toward those in need, emphasizing that helping the poor and vulnerable is a sacred duty. Leviticus 25:35 calls for strengthening and relieving the poor, including strangers and sojourners, while Deuteronomy 14:28-29 and 15:7 command the provision of resources and warn against hardening one’s heart toward brethren in need. Proverbs highlights the spiritual value of humility and kindness, teaching that giving to the poor is like lending to the Lord, who will repay such deeds, thus encouraging a Christ-centered attitude of mercy and faithful stewardship.
